title: wtctl baseline check --json
description: The unchanged case (exit 0). A change exits 20 with error.json: reason repo_config_changed, items, details {digest, recorded_digest, changed_classes}.

format.description: Present only for a record whose baseline was recorded in an older format: 1 before symlink targets were covered, 2 before verified linked worktrees beneath the worktree were skipped, 3 before the admin entry's info/sparse-checkout was covered. It is compared by the collector that recorded it; baseline accept re-records it as format 4.

uncovered.description: Only when not empty: the paths of symlinks whose target is on another device or mount (not /dev/null). The baseline records their hop targets and the path of the first entry on the other device but reads nothing behind them, so a change of that content is not detected. Only positions nothing runs or parses can be uncovered (CLAUDE*.md, info/exclude, the core.excludesFile target, alternates); elsewhere such a link is refused. The array is complete (bounded by the shared entry budget); the stderr list and the status warning are cut with a (+N more) count. A notice, never a failure; also printed to stderr and shown by status as a warning.

new_coverage.description: Only with format, and only when not empty: the items a baseline accept would add or change (symlink targets, linked-worktree items, the directory items that stop listing a linked worktree and the info/sparse-checkout item); one with a detail would block it. A notice, never a failure.
